content: अयोग {%a.%} .²1 Unconnected with. .²2 Indistinctly connected. .²3 Making vigorous efforts. .{@-गः@} .²1 Separation, disjunction, interval. .²2 Unfitness, impropriety, incongruity. .²3 An improper conjunction. .²4 Inefficacy of a remedy or medicine (as of a purgative or emetic). .²5 Strong or vigorous effort. .²6 Medical treatment against the symptoms. .²7 Non-application or misapplication of remedies. .²8 A sort of disease (cured by prescribing emetics). .²9 A widower; absent lover or husband (विधुर). .²10 A hammer (for अयोग्र, अयोघन). .²11 Dislike. .²12 A conjunction of two planets (also inauspicious). .²13 Falling from the practice of Yoga; दत्तस्त्वयोगादथ योगनाथः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 8. 16</ls>.
